messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary deploy started for chart=platform-ui, release=canary-platform-ui, chart_version=3.2.1. Running preflight checks... logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/12ab34

ci-bot: preflight result: FAILED - values drift detected on ConfigMap/ui-config (expected hash=abc123, found=def456).

mike: saw the alert. blast radius? is this only the canary or will this affect stable?

sylvia: only canary namespace (prod-canary) so blast radius ~10% traffic. The drift is in values override: feature_flags.enable_new_search=true on the canary, but our staged values have it false. That flips a flag that hits the search adapter path.

jen: do we have a diff? can we see what Helm/patch applied?

ci-bot: helm diff summary:
```
--- values.yaml
- search.enabled: true
+ search.enabled: false
```
(full diff: https://ci.redwood.internal/diffs/789)

mike: two options: 1) patch canary values to match staged (disable new_search), 2) rollback canary to previous chart (3.2.0) and pin chart_version in pipeline. I'm leaning rollback for safety given possible NPE in search path.

sylvia: +1 rollback. We don't want a partial flag flip in prod traffic. Also we should pin chart version in the release job to avoid accidental auto-updates. I'll open a quick PR after rollback.

jen: agree with rollback. I'll update release notes afterwards with the incident blurb.

mike: @deploy-bot can you run rollback to 3.2.0 for canary? include post-rollback smoke check.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Scheduling rollback: helm rollback canary-platform-ui 1 --namespace prod-canary (target chart_version=3.2.0). Estimated duration: ~30s. Will run smoke checks (health endpoint + 5 p50 latencies).

deploy-bot: Running:
```bash
helm rollback canary-platform-ui 1 --namespace prod-canary
kubectl rollout status deploy/platform-ui --namespace prod-canary --timeout=120s
```

ci-bot: smoke checks: GET /health -> 200, p50 latency 120ms (baseline 130ms). No 5xx seen in logs in last 2m.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Rollback complete. canary-platform-ui is now at chart_version=3.2.0. Observability snapshots: https://monitoring.redwood/internal/snapshots/cc3

mike: Nice. Thanks. Sylvia, can you follow up on pinning chart_version and adding a preflight strictness gate that compares values hash between staged and deploy pipeline?

sylvia: on it. I'll create a PR to the release pipeline: add values-hash check and optional strict mode flag. Also adding a job to validate values against target cluster configmaps.

jen: I'll add a short blurb to the release notes and create a post-incident note for the weekly eng-releases sync.

mike: tagging this for postmortem/ops: create issue to track runbook updates and pipeline change, assign to @sylvia.

deploy-bot: Follow-up issue created: https://issues.redwood/internal/ISSUE-462 (title: enforce values-hash preflight + pin chart versions).

jen: thanks all :thumbsup:

mike: closing thread once PRs are opened.

sylvia: PR opened: https://git.redwood/internal/release-pipeline/pulls/88 (adds values-hash check + chart pin optional).

mike: looks good. closing.
